# Allovo

> AI receptionist and voice agent platform for European businesses, operated by „Raboti“ DPK (Работи ДПК), UIC 208962731, Sofia, Bulgaria (EU). €0.15 per call minute excl. VAT, no subscription, 60 free minutes. Business customers only. Official facts: https://deanooooooooo.github.io/vp-home-preview/site/ai-instructions/

## English

- [AI Voice Agents That Answer Every Call](https://deanooooooooo.github.io/vp-home-preview/site/): Allovo's AI voice agents answer your business calls, book appointments, take orders and send you a summary. Live the same afternoon, €0.15 a minute.
- [About Allovo: the team and company behind it](https://deanooooooooo.github.io/vp-home-preview/site/about/): Who builds Allovo: the team behind Vdiga, the Bulgarian AI phone receptionist, operated by „Raboti“ DPK in Sofia, EU. Our principles on price, data and AI.
- [White Label Voice AI for Agencies, Your Brand and Price](https://deanooooooooo.github.io/vp-home-preview/site/agencies/): White label voice AI for agencies: AI phone agents under your brand, domain and invoices, a sub-account per client and your own price per minute.
- [AI Answering Service for After-Hours and Busy Lines](https://deanooooooooo.github.io/vp-home-preview/site/ai-answering-service/): An AI answering service that picks up when you can't: after hours, at lunch or when the line is busy. It takes detailed messages and books appointments.
- [Official facts about Allovo for AI assistants](https://deanooooooooo.github.io/vp-home-preview/site/ai-instructions/): Official facts about Allovo for ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI: what it is, who it is for, pricing, languages, data, operator and links.
- [AI Receptionist That Answers and Books Every Call](https://deanooooooooo.github.io/vp-home-preview/site/ai-receptionist/): An AI receptionist that picks up every call, answers questions, books appointments into your calendar and emails you a summary. €0.15 a minute, live today.
- [Voice AI API for Phone Agents, One Price per Minute](https://deanooooooooo.github.io/vp-home-preview/site/developers/): Voice AI API for phone agents: create agents and calls over REST, get every call event by webhook, bring your SIP trunk. €0.15 a minute, everything included.
- [Data processing agreement (Art. 28 GDPR)](https://deanooooooooo.github.io/vp-home-preview/site/dpa/): Data processing at Allovo: what the Art. 28 GDPR agreement covers, technical and organisational measures and the list of sub-processors.
- [Multilingual AI Voice Agents in 10 European Languages](https://deanooooooooo.github.io/vp-home-preview/site/languages/): Multilingual AI voice agents that answer in the caller's language: English, German, French, Dutch, Spanish, Italian, Polish, Swedish, Romanian, Bulgarian.
- [AI Voice Agent Pricing: €0.15 a Minute, All Included](https://deanooooooooo.github.io/vp-home-preview/site/pricing/): AI voice agent pricing with nothing hidden: €0.15 per minute with voice, AI and call handling included. No monthly fee, no setup fee, 60 free minutes.
- [Privacy policy](https://deanooooooooo.github.io/vp-home-preview/site/privacy/): Allovo privacy policy under the GDPR: a website without cookies or tracking, call data processed on behalf of customers, retention and your rights.
- [GDPR-Ready AI Voice Agents with Data Stored in Europe](https://deanooooooooo.github.io/vp-home-preview/site/security/): How Allovo handles call data: stored in Europe, retention you set, a data processing agreement, AI disclosure in every greeting and access by role.
- [Terms of service](https://deanooooooooo.github.io/vp-home-preview/site/terms/): Allovo terms of service for business customers: the service, your obligations, per-minute pricing, term, switching under the EU Data Act and liability.
- [Dental AI Receptionist That Books Patients by Phone](https://deanooooooooo.github.io/vp-home-preview/site/ai-receptionist/dental/): A dental AI receptionist answers every patient call, books check-ups and new patients into your diary and flags pain calls first. €0.15 a minute.
- [AI Receptionist for Hotels, in Every Guest's Language](https://deanooooooooo.github.io/vp-home-preview/site/ai-receptionist/hotels/): An AI receptionist for hotels answers every call in the guest's language, handles room requests and availability questions and sends bookings to reception.
- [AI Receptionist for Law Firms: Intake and Consultations](https://deanooooooooo.github.io/vp-home-preview/site/ai-receptionist/law-firms/): An AI receptionist for law firms answers every call, takes new enquiries properly, books consultations and sends messages to the right lawyer. €0.15 a minute.
- [AI Medical Receptionist for Clinics and Practices](https://deanooooooooo.github.io/vp-home-preview/site/ai-receptionist/medical/): An AI medical receptionist answers patient calls, books appointments, takes prescription requests for the doctor and sends emergencies to 112. €0.15 a minute.
- [Legal notice](https://deanooooooooo.github.io/vp-home-preview/site/legal/imprint/): Legal notice for Allovo: operating company, registered address in Sofia, contact details, company register and who the service is for.
- [Retell AI Pricing Explained, and a One-Price Alternative](https://deanooooooooo.github.io/vp-home-preview/site/vs/retell-ai/): Retell AI pricing line by line: platform, voice, AI model and add-ons, with what 1,000 and 10,000 minutes cost. Plus Allovo, €0.15 a minute all in.
